##### Project general facts

Dubai Wharf is a waterfront residential development located along Dubai Creek, combining contemporary architecture with traditional Arabic influences and scenic waterfront views. Spanning over 2.3 million sq. ft., the development features a collection of low-rise buildings connected by a central promenade, creating a vibrant and pedestrian-friendly environment. The project offers a selection of residences designed around modern urban living, with a strong connection to the surrounding waterfront setting.

The community provides a wide range of amenities designed to support a comfortable and active lifestyle. Residents can enjoy swimming pools, a fitness centre, landscaped gardens, children’s play areas, and a variety of retail and dining options. At the heart of the development, the central promenade creates a lively social hub with cafés, restaurants, and shops, while the waterfront setting offers a pleasant environment for leisurely walks and outdoor activities.

The residences feature spacious layouts, high-quality finishes, and large windows designed to maximise natural light and views of the surrounding area. Thoughtfully planned interiors provide comfortable and functional living spaces, with a range of configurations available to suit different needs. The kitchens are equipped, while the residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Creek Harbour is a large-scale waterfront development project located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The project aims to create a new, world-class urban destination that combines residential, commercial, retail, and leisure elements. One of the main features of Dubai Creek Harbour is its strategic location alongside the historic Dubai Creek and adjacent to the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. Spanning an area of approximately 6 square kilometers, the development is designed to provide a seamless blend of natural beauty and modern city living.

The centerpiece of Dubai Creek Harbour is the iconic Dubai Creek Tower, which is set to be the tallest structure in the world. This architectural marvel will serve as a focal point and a symbol of Dubai's ambition and innovation. Surrounding the tower, the development will feature a vibrant central district with residential towers, hotels, and commercial spaces.

Dubai Creek Harbour also aims to be a self-sustained community with an array of amenities and facilities. These include retail outlets, dining options, entertainment venues, schools, healthcare facilities, and landscaped parks. The development is designed to prioritize pedestrian-friendly spaces, ensuring a walkable environment with plenty of open spaces for residents and visitors to enjoy. In terms of connectivity, Dubai Creek Harbour benefits from its proximity to major transportation networks. It has convenient access to major highways, connecting it to other parts of Dubai and beyond. The development is also planned to have its own dedicated metro station, further enhancing its accessibility.
